about: Journey stages of Volume 1. Every story beat has a scene slot (scenes/before, scenes/after) written in story/scenes_v1c*.json.

records.name: Dream of the Withered Garden
records.beat: A dream of the Withering: four flower immortals fight wraiths at the Jade Pool. Tao Yao's voice guides the first battle (the tutorial), then the Garden burns.

heavenDefying.mechanic: Enemies gain boss mechanics: Qi shields on elites, sharper targeting (chance 0 to +0.3)

records.name: The Ruined Pavilion
records.beat: You wake in the ruined Hundred Blossoms Pavilion. Tao Yao introduces herself and the Fate Lotus; the first guided summon. Smoke rises from Peach Blossom Ford.

records.name: Smoke over the Ford
records.beat: Wraiths set the river village alight. Village Chief He leads the refugees toward the temple.

heavenDefying.mechanic: Enemies gain boss mechanics: Qi shields on elites, sharper targeting (chance 0 to +0.3)

records.name: The Lotus Shield
records.beat: Su Lianhua holds a jade lotus shield over the refugees. She fights beside you, and names the cultists: the Netherflame Sect.

heavenDefying.mechanic: Enemies gain boss mechanics: Qi shields on elites, sharper targeting (chance 0 to +0.3)

records.name: The Ferryman's Plea
records.beat: Old Liu the Ferryman lost his ferry to river ghouls stirred up by the wraiths. Win it back so the refugees can cross.

heavenDefying.mechanic: Enemies gain boss mechanics: Qi shields on elites, sharper targeting (chance 0 to +0.3)

records.name: A Peddler on the Road
records.beat: Old Qian of the Myriad Treasures Guild sells odds and ends from his cart and gossips about the Guild.

records.name: Ashes of the Peach Grove
records.beat: The cultists burn the orchards to draw out the temple's healer. Abbess Huiming asks you to protect Su Lianhua.

heavenDefying.mechanic: Enemies gain boss mechanics: Qi shields on elites, sharper targeting (chance 0 to +0.3)

records.name: Wraith Captain of the Ford
records.beat: The Wraith Captain who led the raid. After his fall, Su Lianhua senses her Dao Seed answering the Fate Lotus, and joins the Pavilion.

heavenDefying.mechanic: Enemies gain boss mechanics: Qi shields on elites, sharper targeting (chance 0 to +0.3)

records.name: The Frozen Pass
records.beat: Climbing to Frostpeak through wolf country; frozen bodies of Frostpeak disciples on the path.

heavenDefying.mechanic: Enemies gain boss mechanics: Qi shields on elites, sharper targeting (chance 0 to +0.3)

records.name: Disciples in Chains
records.beat: Ling Shuang, alone, attacks a prisoner convoy. You join her.

heavenDefying.mechanic: Enemies gain boss mechanics: Qi shields on elites, sharper targeting (chance 0 to +0.3)

records.name: She Will Not Kneel
records.beat: In the sect hall Elder Han Lie orders Ling Shuang to kneel and accept the Netherflame "alliance". She refuses and is cast out.

records.name: Crane Cliffs
records.beat: Elder He Ling of the Crane Clan will reveal the secret path into the sect only if you best her dancers.

heavenDefying.mechanic: Enemies gain boss mechanics: Qi shields on elites, sharper targeting (chance 0 to +0.3)

records.name: Blizzard Ambush
records.beat: The traitors ambush you in a blizzard on the secret path.

heavenDefying.mechanic: Enemies gain boss mechanics: Qi shields on elites, sharper targeting (chance 0 to +0.3)

records.name: The Fortune Teller in the Snow
records.beat: Old Seer Bai, somehow on a snowbound cliff, reads Ling Shuang's fate: a plum that blooms for the Garden.

records.name: Hall of the Sword Tombs
records.beat: Wraiths raised from Frostpeak's sword tombs guard the prison stair.

heavenDefying.mechanic: Enemies gain boss mechanics: Qi shields on elites, sharper targeting (chance 0 to +0.3)

records.name: Freeing the Sect Master
records.beat: Ling Shuang frees Sect Master Bai Xue, who tells her the elder sold the disciples for a Netherflame pill.

heavenDefying.mechanic: Enemies gain boss mechanics: Qi shields on elites, sharper targeting (chance 0 to +0.3)

records.name: Elder Han's Betrayal
records.beat: Elder Han Lie, burning with netherflame. Ling Shuang cuts down her elder and follows the thread of fate to the Pavilion.

heavenDefying.mechanic: Enemies gain boss mechanics: Qi shields on elites, sharper targeting (chance 0 to +0.3)

records.name: Into the Bamboo Sea
records.beat: Following rumours of a Netherflame buyer into the endless bamboo.

heavenDefying.mechanic: Enemies gain boss mechanics: Qi shields on elites, sharper targeting (chance 0 to +0.3)

records.name: A Blade in the Night
records.beat: Assassins strike your camp. In the confusion a violet blade reaches your throat, and stops.

heavenDefying.mechanic: Enemies gain boss mechanics: Qi shields on elites, sharper targeting (chance 0 to +0.3)

records.name: The Contract
records.beat: Mo Yingyue explains: she was paid to kill you, but the client lied about who you are. A Moonshadow contract with a lie in it is void.

records.name: Fox Clan Toll
records.beat: Lady Hu Qiao demands a toll to cross Fox Clan ground: a test of strength, then a favour owed.

heavenDefying.mechanic: Enemies gain boss mechanics: Qi shields on elites, sharper targeting (chance 0 to +0.3)

records.name: Spider Hollows
records.beat: Mo Yingyue guides you through the spider hollows to the client's meeting place.

heavenDefying.mechanic: Enemies gain boss mechanics: Qi shields on elites, sharper targeting (chance 0 to +0.3)

records.name: A Spirit Beast in a Snare
records.beat: A koi spirit tangled in a cultist snare by a bamboo pool. Freeing it leaves an egg behind.

records.name: Moonshadow Pavilion
records.beat: Netherflame agents besiege Moonshadow Pavilion to silence Mo Yingyue. Madam Yue judges the broken contract.

heavenDefying.mechanic: Enemies gain boss mechanics: Qi shields on elites, sharper targeting (chance 0 to +0.3)

records.name: Puppets of Ku Ye
records.beat: The client's stone puppets: the smiling Envoy Ku Ye of the Netherflame Sect.

heavenDefying.mechanic: Enemies gain boss mechanics: Qi shields on elites, sharper targeting (chance 0 to +0.3)

records.name: Envoy Ku Ye
records.beat: Ku Ye fights, then flees through the earth. Mo Yingyue signs a new contract, with you, payable in candied hawthorns.

heavenDefying.mechanic: Enemies gain boss mechanics: Qi shields on elites, sharper targeting (chance 0 to +0.3)

records.name: Ash Roads
records.beat: The volcanic roads to the Phoenix Palace are full of hounds made of ash.

heavenDefying.mechanic: Enemies gain boss mechanics: Qi shields on elites, sharper targeting (chance 0 to +0.3)

records.name: The Empty Altar
records.beat: The sealed fire is gone. Yan Feihong accuses you of the theft, and Elder Zhu Yan sends her with you to find the thief.

records.name: Trial by Fire
records.beat: Yan Feihong tests you in battle against netherflame casters who came for the fire too.

heavenDefying.mechanic: Enemies gain boss mechanics: Qi shields on elites, sharper targeting (chance 0 to +0.3)

records.name: Serpent Marsh Detour
records.beat: Chief Bai Lin of the Serpent Clan knows where the thief went, in exchange for clearing a nest of rogue guards.

heavenDefying.mechanic: Enemies gain boss mechanics: Qi shields on elites, sharper targeting (chance 0 to +0.3)

records.name: Fox Tracks in the Ash
records.beat: Silver fox hairs and illusions in the ash: the thief is a renegade of the Fox Clan.

heavenDefying.mechanic: Enemies gain boss mechanics: Qi shields on elites, sharper targeting (chance 0 to +0.3)

records.name: Old Qian's Rare Wares
records.beat: Old Qian, sweating in the heat, sells fire-proof goods and admits the Guild once bought a feather from a silver fox.

records.name: Magma Halls
records.beat: Through the old palace's magma halls toward the thief's den.

heavenDefying.mechanic: Enemies gain boss mechanics: Qi shields on elites, sharper targeting (chance 0 to +0.3)

records.name: Phoenix Palace Gate
records.beat: The Netherflame Sect arrives to buy the stolen fire from the thief. You get there first.

heavenDefying.mechanic: Enemies gain boss mechanics: Qi shields on elites, sharper targeting (chance 0 to +0.3)

records.name: The Silver Fox
records.beat: Hu Yinling stole the fire to pay a debt to Ku Ye. Defeated, she returns it; Yan Feihong, grudgingly impressed, joins the Pavilion.

heavenDefying.mechanic: Enemies gain boss mechanics: Qi shields on elites, sharper targeting (chance 0 to +0.3)

records.name: The Last Road
records.beat: The four Blossoms march with you toward the sealed gate of the Garden.

heavenDefying.mechanic: Enemies gain boss mechanics: Qi shields on elites, sharper targeting (chance 0 to +0.3)

records.name: Council of the Sects
records.beat: Frostpeak, Moonshadow, the Phoenix Palace and the Jade Lotus Temple meet at the Tianji Pavilion. Scribe Lu reveals the Matriarch harvests Dao Seeds to free the Sovereign.

records.name: Wraith Tide
records.beat: A tide of wraiths pours from the cracks around the gate.

heavenDefying.mechanic: Enemies gain boss mechanics: Qi shields on elites, sharper targeting (chance 0 to +0.3)

records.name: The Clans' Pact
records.beat: The fox, serpent and crane clans will join the defence if the Pavilion proves itself against their champions.

heavenDefying.mechanic: Enemies gain boss mechanics: Qi shields on elites, sharper targeting (chance 0 to +0.3)

records.name: Netherflame Vanguard
records.beat: The Matriarch's vanguard holds the approach.

heavenDefying.mechanic: Enemies gain boss mechanics: Qi shields on elites, sharper targeting (chance 0 to +0.3)

records.name: The Black Tortoise Seal
records.beat: Ku Ye tries to break the Black Tortoise seal of the northern gate. This time he does not escape.

heavenDefying.mechanic: Enemies gain boss mechanics: Qi shields on elites, sharper targeting (chance 0 to +0.3)

records.name: A Seer's Warning
records.beat: Old Seer Bai tells the Pavilion Master the truth Tao Yao has hidden: you were the Garden's Gardener.

records.name: Through the Withered Garden
records.beat: Beyond the gate lies the Garden as it is now: ash, and flowers that remember you.

heavenDefying.mechanic: Enemies gain boss mechanics: Qi shields on elites, sharper targeting (chance 0 to +0.3)

records.name: Before the Throne of Ash
records.beat: The Matriarch's honour guard at the burned heart of the Garden.

heavenDefying.mechanic: Enemies gain boss mechanics: Qi shields on elites, sharper targeting (chance 0 to +0.3)

records.name: The Netherflame Matriarch
records.beat: The Matriarch descends. Shattered, she flees into the Netherworld rift, vowing the Sovereign's return. The Pavilion rises again, and Volume 1 ends.

heavenDefying.mechanic: Enemies gain boss mechanics: Qi shields on elites, sharper targeting (chance 0 to +0.3)
